item.title: Residential vs Commercial Cleaning 2026: Which to Start
item.description: Almost everyone who decides to start a cleaning business asks the same question first: should I clean homes or offices? The two look like the same trade from the outside — a person with supplies making a space clean — but they are two different businesses with different startup costs, different margins, different sales cycles, and completely different cash-flow rhythms. Pick the wrong one for your situation and you spend a year fighting the model instead of building the business.
